scope: Five basic structures/five known-source transfer probes. Independent color/layer review, not runtime reproduction score, novice/model benchmark or CNS acceptance claim.

baseline.origin: Actual published main candidates before this color revision
baseline.distinction: validation baseline records are baseline-spec demonstration outputs, not frozen adopted candidates. Actual published-before violin already has quartile/median layer.

preferences.reason: Graphite open boundaries and raw dots are crisper on white at nominal final size; five x positions already identify treatments. The optional neutral-filled variant adds broad gray mass without improving this 15-point task.
preferences.remaining_gap: Unchanged sparse 110 x 88 mm geometry remains broader than many small scWAT subpanels; color changes cannot establish literature-level proportion.

preferences.reason: Blue and pink remain bright and distinct in this actual 127-point cloud, without obscuring black axis text. Difference from published blue/coral is modest.
preferences.remaining_gap: Blue/terra also decodes; no universal blue/pink superiority, color-vision accessibility, or grayscale distinction is verified.

preferences.reason: Limited violet/mint/salmon IQR areas anchor summaries; graphite medians, whiskers and opaque raw lanes separate observations from categorical color. No inter-category touching or value clipping is visible.
preferences.remaining_gap: Raw lanes are all graphite and associate by proximity/x position. Tiny marks at 96 dpi cannot all be independently counted reliably.

preferences.reason: White KDE bodies with 0.5 pt graphite contours and colored IQR regions have sharper boundaries than former tinted bodies/colored raw lanes. Density, quartiles and medians remain distinct.
preferences.remaining_gap: Flat trimmed endpoints remain legitimate but less tapered than some paper examples. Raw distribution dots remain small at nominal preview size.

preferences.reason: Published-before and current main PNG hashes are identical. Sequential positive blue, 48 values, seams and aliases remain readable; there is no palette improvement.
preferences.remaining_gap: Fixed narrow matrix and label-heavy geometry are inherited; no new color evidence.

literature_color_roles.observed: Blue/pink fitted lines, matching points and legend distinguish YT-FF/YT-AKO. Line colors are not universally prescribed raw-point colors.
literature_color_roles.adapted: Current scatter maps supplied vector-line hues #3795D3/#FF5FBD to infection-class raw points, with no fit or source-paper biological identity inferred.
literature_color_roles.verification_limit: Visible page/role interpretation checked; exact PDF vector hex extraction supplied and not independently repeated.

literature_color_roles.observed: White/open bars with black or ochre contours, small raw points/squares, dark axes and error lines; color separates two actual conditions.
literature_color_roles.adapted: Single-outcome bars use graphite open contours/points because x positions encode treatments. A role-informed choice, not exact replication of a two-condition paper panel.
literature_color_roles.verification_limit: Page 5 freshly rendered from local scWAT.pdf and actually inspected.

literature_color_roles.observed: Neutral violin contours plus inner summaries. Violet/mint encode mutation-status summaries; salmon/yellow/gray also appear in pathway-quartile KDE areas. Multiple layer/color roles coexist.
literature_color_roles.adapted: Cohort colors are confined to IQR areas; raw points and contours are graphite, violin bodies white. Salmon is reassigned from a KDE-area source role to IQR area. Biological meanings/layout not transferred.
literature_color_roles.verification_limit: Visible region roles/caption inspected; exact hex samples supplied, not independently extracted.

findings.initial_issue: Inner boxes called open although actual Q1-Q3 regions are filled.
findings.verified_resolution: Actual caption now says Inner filled boxes, retaining quartile definition.

findings.initial_issue: All three sampled hues were described as PDF summary fills, whereas PROGENy salmon is observed in density/pathway areas.
findings.verified_resolution: Captions now say selected PDF area fills; explicitly include inner summaries and colored density/pathway areas and label application to cohort IQR regions as an EasyViz adaptation.

residual_notes: Neutral open bars suit this single-quantity task, not a universal publication palette.
Small dense raw marks read as distributions; individual countability of all 129/185 observations at 96 dpi is not proven. Higher contrast cannot guarantee no missing/overlapped marks.
Fixed geometry, numeric scales, point sizes and category lanes are unchanged; no proportion refinement is claimed.
Blue/pink is acceptable in this actual cloud. Applying it to larger filled regions/many categories is untested.
Color-vision simulations, grayscale proofing and print reproduction were not performed.
Different-data paper panels are design references, not skill/model causal evidence or publication-grade proof.
